title: ROYAL DOULTON JUG - HERBERT BETTERLEY 1890
findings: Royal Doulton blush ivory jug with frilled spout, gilt handle and transfer-outlined, hand-coloured floral decoration. Base has the printed green Royal Doulton lion and crown mark (Royal Doulton England, used from 1902 onward) and a later handwritten paper label 'Hand Decorated by Doulton Painter Herbert Betteley 1890'. The printed mark contradicts an 1890 date (Burslem pre-1902 mark would differ); no painter signature visible on the body, so the Betteley attribution is only a label claim.
condition: Gilding worn on rim and foot, staining/residue on base, no obvious chips seen.
reason: Royal Doulton Burslem blush ware jug, collectable maker; artist and 1890 date unsupported.
marks_read: Royal Doulton England lion and crown (green); paper label 'Herbert Betteley 1890'
